evals.prompt: Stand up (or bring current) the value-stream meta-repo for a polyrepo product org.
evals.expected_output: A value-stream meta-repo holding only cross-cutting artifacts (no application code): a federated Backstage catalog that references each component's own catalog-info.yaml rather than copying it; a settled home for the shared contract (the choice named with alternatives), where each per-component brief references contract@version with a read-only courier snapshot; a single C4 / bounded-context architecture that component repos link to; and a cross-component delivery rollup that is an AND across rows, where an absent-source row reads as unknown/not-yet-catalogued rather than silently delivered. Currency is treated as the spine.
assertions: Holds only cross-cutting artifacts — no application code lives in the meta-repo
Federates the catalog — references each component's catalog-info.yaml rather than re-authoring or copying it
Settles where the shared contract lives (choice named with alternatives); each brief references contract@version with a read-only snapshot, not attach-as-authority
Anchors a single C4 / bounded-context architecture that component repos link to
Rollup is an AND across rows; an absent-source row reads as unknown/not-catalogued, never silently delivered
Treats currency as the spine — addresses the stale-map failure mode

evals.prompt: Which product-engineering skills read the [product] layout section?
evals.expected_output: The complete list of eight [product] readers: intent, align-value-stream, frame-situation, identify-opportunities, diverge-solutions, place-bet, map-capabilities, and lean-canvas. It distinguishes lean-canvas as scanning the section while writing a pinned path.
assertions: Names exactly the eight [product] readers: intent, align-value-stream, frame-situation, identify-opportunities, diverge-solutions, place-bet, map-capabilities, and lean-canvas
Distinguishes lean-canvas reading [product] to scan from writing its pinned path

evals.prompt: Anchor the system architecture for the value-stream meta-repo. The architect pack is not in the available-skills roster.
evals.expected_output: The skill anchors the C4 / bounded-context reference in the meta-repo itself and continues silently, with no mention of the missing architect skill.
assertions: Anchors the system C4 / bounded-context reference.md in the meta-repo that component repos link to
Does not mention architect-design, its absence, or installing anything
Continues with the skill's own procedure and reaches the rollup step without an error

evals.prompt: Stand up the value-stream meta-repo and tell me what limits the team must accept.
evals.expected_output: The skill proposes the Hard limits section from its asset for the solution repo's README, shows it, and writes only after confirmation.
assertions: Proposes a ## Hard limits README section naming no atomic cross-repo commit, no shared release train, and the rollup as a snapshot, not a live feed
Shows the section text and writes the README only after the user confirms
Does not overwrite an existing Hard limits section without the user's acceptance
